_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); automaker signals, the early era

pit_profile.why: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Industry sales volume in any of Ford’s key markets can be volatile and could decline if there is a financial crisis, recession, or significant geopolitical event.' and 'Ford’s results are dependent on sales of larger, more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2020 10-K); EV (live from about 2020) is not on the watch list: no risk factor of this 10-K names a shift away from Ford's combustion-engine vehicles, so its words on larger, more profitable vehicles stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Industry sales volume in any of Ford’s key markets can be volatile and could decline if there is a financial crisis, recession, or significant geopolitical event.' and 'Ford’s results are dependent on sales of larger, more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2020 10-K); EV (live from about 2020) is not on the watch list: no risk factor of this 10-K names a shift away from Ford's combustion-engine vehicles, so its words on larger, more profitable vehicles stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +399% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.00; conservative 2yr -77%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -65.5%/yr (worst year FY11-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-9.1%/yr (Q4 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +-9.1%/yr (FY11-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +14.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: F (retrospective, 2021-03-05) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (100.0% downside to Bear $0 / +-75.6% upside to Bull $3) | Adj composite 1.75 vs market 3.75: gap -2.00 [OVERVALUED] | +399% above the EPP floor $2 (6x FY21E $0.41) | Conservative 2-yr case: -76.6% total (-38.3%/yr) | At 29.9x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $16 sits above the BULL case; wholesale units -8.4% in Q4 2020, forward revenues -9.5% (no Q1 2021 revenue guide, Q4 2020 revenue as reported); EV is live but no 10-K risk factor names a shift away from Ford's combustion-engine vehicles yet.
